newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower as spread widens.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower as spread widens.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended lower in choppy, sluggish dealings, although the Dec/March inverse widened on strength in the cash market for high-protein spring wheat, traders said.
Traders said the December/March spread was bid at 11 cents per bushel early and widened to trade at 13-3/4 cents per bushel by the session's close.
MGE spring wheat settled 1-1/2 to three cents per bushel lower, with Dec down 1-1/2 cents at $4.16-1/4. March lost three cents to close at $4.00-1/2.
Some traders said weak export sales data contributed to wheat's overall weakness Tuesday.
Traders said Frontier Futures bought 2.6 million Dec bushels and 1.1 million March. LFG sold one million Dec. Benson-Quinn bought one million Dec and sold one million Dec and one million May.
